missing: Under `python -m detpy unittest --det --det-cache`, one test that calls `uuid.uuid4()` makes every later test class of the process not cacheable ("after an earlier test or fixture of this process"): 0 of 3 tests reused on the second run, and the receipts say "new: no recorded result" every time.
evidence: scratch poison/tests/test_ut_poison.py, py3.12: 2x `python -m detpy unittest --det --det-cache=.cu tests/test_ut_poison.py` => 2nd run "reused 0 result(s) with proof, ran 3 ... not cacheable: after an earlier test or fixture of this process 2, os entropy (not controlled; use --det-urandom) 1" (notes A12)

missing: Plain `python -m unittest ...` cannot be made deterministic in place: there is no plugin, environment variable or `sitecustomize` hook; the CI command itself must be rewritten to `python -m detpy unittest --det ...`. `unittest.main()` in a module run as a script (`python test_x.py`) is not covered at all.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/__init__.py:13-20 (shells are sub-commands of `detpy` only); docs/runners/unittest.md "Not covered": "`unittest.main()` inside a test module run as a script (`python test_x.py`): not through the driver"

missing: `detpy repro`, `detpy explore` and `detpy replay` (find the failing seed/order, minimise, prove 10/10, write a bundle, nightly exploration) exist only for pytest: they always launch `python -m pytest ... --det`. A flaky unittest test (run through the unittest shell) has no repro, no exploration and no replay bundle.
evidence: python/detpy/repro.py:88 `cmd = [self.python, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--det", ...]`; crates/detpy-core/src/repro.rs:168 `vec!["pytest", "--det"]`; cli.py:37 "--python: interpreter that runs pytest"

missing: No parallel mode under `--det` for the unittest shell (pytest has the xdist plan with proof); a unittest suite runs on one core.
evidence: docs/RELEASE-1.md support table "Python (other runners) | ... | same session, same options | serial"; python/detpy/runners/driver.py has no plan/worker code (`grep -n "isolate\|det_plan" runners/driver.py` => no match)

missing: `--det-isolate` (fork per test, order-dependent tests reported) does not exist for the unittest shell: the option is defined only in the pytest plugin.
evidence: `grep -n "isolate" python/detpy/runners/driver.py` => no match; python/detpy/plugin.py:665 `from . import isolate as _isolate` (pytest only); _level0.OPTIONS (shared table) has no --det-isolate

missing: In the unittest shell the unit of reuse is the whole TestCase class: one changed or uncacheable method reruns every method of its class (documented design), so classes with many methods skip far less than under pytest.
evidence: docs/runners/unittest.md "Unit of reuse: the class ... a class is reused as a whole or not at all (`CacheSession.regroup`, receipt `unit: <test> runs`)"; seen in receipts summary "not reused: ... unit 3" (logs/mx-py312.log)
decide_for: Methods of a class share in-memory class state that the capture cannot see; per-method reuse was shown to keep a stale pass (test_class_state_makes_the_class_the_unit_of_reuse).
decide_against: Django and unittest suites put dozens of methods in one class; a class-wide unit removes most of the skip the product promises for those suites. Class state could be captured or the class forked.

missing: Django's `--parallel N` is forced to 1 under `--det` (message in the summary): Django projects that rely on parallel test processes lose all parallelism, while pytest gets a parallel mode with proof.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/django_runner.py:70-72 `hooks.run.adjust(f"Django --parallel {runner.parallel} -> 1 under --det (one process)"); runner.parallel = 1`; docs/runners/django.md row `--parallel`. Not run here.

missing: `manage.py test` cannot be made deterministic through Django's own extension point: detpy ships no `DiscoverRunner` subclass for `TEST_RUNNER`, so the project must change its command to `python -m detpy django manage.py test --det`; tools that call `manage.py test` themselves (tox envs, IDEs, `django-admin test` wrappers) are not covered.
evidence: `grep -rn "class .*DiscoverRunner\|TEST_RUNNER" python/detpy` => no match; docs/runners/django.md "Use"

missing: With a database other than sqlite (PostgreSQL, MySQL: the normal case for real Django projects) no Django test is ever skipped with proof: a test that talks to the server through a socket is refused by the capture, loopback included.
evidence: docs/runners/django.md "Not covered": "Databases other than sqlite: the database server's state is not an input (a test that reads it through a socket is not cached: the capture refuses network connections, loopback included)". Not run here.

missing: Every Django test's cache key contains the whole process environment (Django's test client imports `wsgiref.handlers`, which reads every variable), so results are not reused between CI jobs or machines whose environments differ in any variable; the doc defers it to a founder decision on "volatile variables".
evidence: docs/runners/django.md "Not covered": "Every Django test depends on the whole environment ... Reuse across CI jobs whose environments differ needs the founder's decision on volatile variables". Not run here.
decide_for: Treating the enumeration as an input is the sound reading: any variable could change a result.
decide_against: CI environments always differ (run id, job id, tokens): with the whole environment in the key the shared cache never hits for Django, the largest Python web framework.

missing: `detpy repro` / `explore` / `replay` do not exist for Django's runner (they launch pytest only): a flaky `manage.py test` test has no repro command, no nightly exploration, no bundle.
evidence: python/detpy/repro.py:88 (always `python -m pytest ... --det`); cli.py:36-55

missing: nose2's multiprocess plugin (`-N` / `--processes`) is refused under `--det` (usage error, exit 4); turned on from a config file its workers run outside the engine and nothing is reused. No parallel mode for nose2.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/nose2_runner.py:62-63 `raise UsageError("nose2's multiprocess plugin (-N / --processes) is not supported under --det ...")`; docs/runners/nose2.md "Refused". Not run here.

missing: nose2's `layers` plugin is not wired: a layer's set-up is attributed to the global context (an input of every test), so any change in one layer reruns the whole suite.
evidence: docs/runners/nose2.md "Refused": "nose2's `layers` plugin: not wired (no layer contexts); a layer's set-up runs between tests (global context: an input of every test, sound, coarse)". Not run here.

missing: `detpy repro` / `explore` / `replay` do not exist for nose2 (pytest only).
evidence: python/detpy/repro.py:88; crates/detpy-core/src/repro.rs:168

missing: zope.testrunner's `-j N` is forced to 1 under `--det`, and layers that cannot be torn down run in a `--resume-layer` subprocess outside the driver: those tests get no detpy fingerprint at all.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/zope_runner.py:71-72 (`zope.testrunner -j N -> 1 under --det`); docs/runners/zope-testrunner.md "Refused / not reused": "the subprocess's tests have no detpy fingerprint". Not run here.

missing: `detpy repro` / `explore` / `replay` do not exist for zope.testrunner (pytest only).
evidence: python/detpy/repro.py:88; crates/detpy-core/src/repro.rs:168

missing: The ward shell replaces `Suite.generate_test_runs` with a copy of ward 0.68.0b0's loop and has no version check: with another ward release whose loop differs the copy silently runs the old logic (the version only enters the cache's configuration digest).
evidence: docs/runners/ward.md "Not covered": "The replaced loop follows ward 0.68.0b0's `generate_test_runs`; another ward version with a different loop needs the copy updated"; python/detpy/runners/ward_runner.py:298-304 (version only passed to `run.configure`). Not run here.

missing: `detpy repro` / `explore` / `replay`, parallel and `--det-isolate` do not exist for ward (pytest only; ward's own `--order random` is overridden).
evidence: python/detpy/repro.py:88; docs/runners/ward.md row "order"; docs/RELEASE-1.md "Python (other runners) ... serial"

missing: `python -m doctest` and `doctest.testmod()` in a module's `__main__` block are not covered; the replacement `python -m detpy doctest` prints unittest's report ("Ran N tests", "FAILED (failures=1)") instead of doctest's own summary, so scripts that parse doctest output break.
evidence: docs/runners/doctest.md: "The report is unittest's ... instead of doctest's own summary" and "Not covered: `doctest.testmod()` called from a module's `__main__` block". Not run here.

missing: Under `--det` Hypothesis's example database is switched off (`settings.database` forced to None): failing examples saved in `.hypothesis/` by earlier runs or by teammates are never replayed, a behaviour Hypothesis users rely on to keep a found bug failing.
evidence: python/detpy/seeds.py:155-160 `type.__setattr__(settings, "database", property(lambda self: None, doc="detpy --det: no example database"))`; docs/runners/hypothesis.md table row "the example database is off". Not run here.
decide_for: Replaying saved examples makes a run depend on history and on files the cache did not key; a seed per test id is reproducible without it.
decide_against: The database is how Hypothesis guarantees a found counter-example is retried first; it could be an explicit, keyed input instead of being disabled.

missing: No support for behave (BDD runner with its own CLI and its own step/feature loading): there is no `detpy behave` shell, so no `--det`, verify, repro, cache or receipts for behave suites.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/__init__.py:13-20 RUNNERS = unittest, django, nose2, doctest, zope-testrunner, ward (no behave); `detpy --help` lists the same six

missing: No support for Robot Framework (`robot` / `python -m robot`): no shell, no `--det`, no cache.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/__init__.py:13-20 (no robot entry); `grep -rli robot docs/ALL-RUNNERS.md docs/runners` => nothing
decide_for: Robot suites are mostly end-to-end/acceptance tests driving external systems, outside Level 0's reach.
decide_against: It is a widely used Python test runner; "any runner" is the promise and at least order/seed/clock control of its Python keyword libraries is possible.

missing: No support for Twisted's `trial` runner (its own reactor-driven loop and `twisted.trial.unittest.TestCase`): no `detpy trial` shell.
evidence: python/detpy/runners/__init__.py:13-20 (no trial entry). Whether `python -m detpy unittest` can run trial TestCases was not checked.
